title: Trial-ending notice, Space-created funnel event, and no wrong price on the Network door
detail: Funnel plumbing on the existing systems, no new admin surface. (1) customer.subscription.trial_will_end now emails the Space owner three days before a trial turns into a charge (lib/billing/trial-ending-email.ts, trial-ending-notify.ts; outbox-deduped per subscription; sample in the stock catalog). The live Stripe webhook endpoint must also have the event enabled; as of 2026-10-22 it did not. (2) createSpace records a first-party space_created engagement row with the setup, plan hint and decideLater flag; never mirrored to GA4. (3) The Network door emits no product Offer in its structured data, because the Business rate would be a wrong price there (ADR-1868).
